title: Align wiki validator test guidance with the README workflow
why: Several generated wiki entry points still tell agents to run `python -m pytest` for the spec validator. `docs/monarchic-launch.md` and `spec/omnisstream-spec/tools/validator/README.md` both document the current repo-local validator flow: expose or install the validator package first, then run `python -m unittest discover -s tools/validator/tests` from `spec/omnisstream-spec`. Refreshing the wiki guidance prevents future workers from following the stale RepoIntel-inferred command.
suggested_scope: Update validator test-command guidance in `docs/wiki/playbook.md`, `docs/wiki/change-guide.md`, `docs/wiki/testing.md`, and `docs/wiki/workflows.md`.
Keep the work documentation-only under the Monarchic default `docs/` write scope; no guarded Rust, FFI, or vendored spec semantic surfaces are required.
Preserve existing generated citations and metadata unless a touched section needs a minimal note explaining the prior `pytest` inference is stale.
validation: rg -n "python -m pytest" docs/wiki/playbook.md docs/wiki/change-guide.md docs/wiki/testing.md docs/wiki/workflows.md

rg -n "python -m unittest discover -s tools/validator/tests" docs/wiki/playbook.md docs/wiki/change-guide.md docs/wiki/testing.md docs/wiki/workflows.md docs/monarchic-launch.md spec/omnisstream-spec/tools/validator/README.md
Because this task is documentation-only, code validation is not required unless the worker chooses to edit validator or CLI sources.
